StatusBot: :rotating_light: ALERT: routing-controller detected surge of cross-region fallbacks from eu-west2 -> us-east1 starting at 2026-03-15T09:05:00Z. p50/p95/p99 latency spiking and ~5% 502s on a subset of customer routes. docs: https://internal.monitoring/r/2603456789
Priya (oncall): ACK, grabbing pager. assigning triage. @Cheng @Luis please ping if you see anything on controller side.
Cheng (eng-runtime): looking. I see a spike in 'pin-override' hits and a bunch of requests being routed to fallback pool despite healthy eu-west2 capacity. getting logs now.
Luis (eng-sre): I can pull LB and route-proxy logs. are these HTTP 502s or backend timeouts?
Support (CS): seeing ~12 customers reporting increased errors, one high-volume customer (acme-media) with 15% error rate on eu-west2 traffic. CS is escalating to SRE.
Rita (netops): DNS TTLs look normal globally, but health-checks from us-east show intermittent 503 from runtime endpoints in eu-west2 around 09:03-09:06Z.
Priya (oncall): timeline so far: monitoring alert 09:05Z -> first customer reports 09:07Z -> oncall paged 09:08Z. Impact: degraded latency and some 5xx errors. severity: P2 for now until we confirm scope.
Cheng (eng-runtime): pasted recent routing-controller log snippet:
```
2026-03-15T09:04:58Z WARN route-eval: policy mismatch: clientPref=eu-west2, pinnedRegion=eu-west2, selected=us-east1, reason=fallback-score>threshold
2026-03-15T09:05:01Z ERROR pin-evaluator: stale-pin-cookie detected id=pin-v2 ttl=3600 last-update=2026-03-12T03:10:00Z
2026-03-15T09:05:10Z INFO route-eval: fallback-invoked target=us-east1 route=public-api user-agent=acme-media
```
Priya (oncall): so controller is choosing fallback even though eu-west2 should be preferred. could be policy weight calc or stale pin cookie inflating fallback score.
Luis (eng-sre): running quick check against controller metrics: `sum(increase(routing.fallback_count[5m])) by (region)` shows spike from eu-west2 at 09:04-09:06. grabbing proxy traces.
Rita (netops): I can try to force-drain pins for the affected prefix in the edge layer if needed. what's the safe command?
Cheng (eng-runtime): can we try a conservative mitigation first: temporarily lower fallback threshold so we prefer pinned region again. command (internal API):
```
# set fallback_threshold to 0.6 -> 0.35
POST https://controlplane.internal/api/v1/routing/config
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "policy": "fallback_threshold",
  "value": 0.35,
  "reason": "emergency prefer pinned region during ongoing anomaly"
}
```
Priya (oncall): do it, Cheng. make sure to annotate for rollback. I'll notify CS and customers.
Cheng (eng-runtime): applied change at 09:11Z. monitoring update in 2m. :hammer_and_wrench:
StatusBot: CONFIG CHANGE: routing policy updated by Cheng at 2026-03-15T09:11:14Z (fallback_threshold=0.35).
Luis (eng-sre): after change p50/p95 improved, p99 still noisy. proxy traces show a small cohort (cookies with pin-v2) are still getting rerouted due to stale last-update timestamps in controller. looks like cookie TTL parsing bug.
Priya (oncall): okay we need to remove stale pins for that cohort. Rita can you run a targeted pin-drain on prefix /v1/ingest for acme-media?
Rita (netops): running targeted drain: `POST /edge/pin/drain {prefix: "/v1/ingest", region: "eu-west2", force: true}`. starting at 09:13Z.
Support (CS): notifying acme-media support lead, sharing mitigation steps and ETA 09:25Z.
Cheng (eng-runtime): open quickfix: patching pin-cookie parser to treat last-update < 24h differently (hotfix). will push a controller canary to staging then to canary hosts in eu-west2.
Luis (eng-sre): canary rolled to 2 hosts at 09:18Z. no regressions. routing errors for acme-media down from 15% -> 2% by 09:22Z. overall error percent across cluster down to 0.7%.
Priya (oncall): handoff to Cheng for deeper debugging and postmortem. I need to go to another incident at 09:25Z. Cheng, you're primary now.
Cheng (eng-runtime): taking over. summary for handoff: applied fallback_threshold change (09:11Z), targeted pin-drain (09:13Z), controller cookie parser canary (09:18Z). customer impact reduced from ~18% traffic affected / multiple customers to <1% errors.
Priya (oncall): thanks. leaving note: PagerDuty incident acknowledged and escalated to SRE. :white_check_mark:
PagerDuty: Incident 124512 acknowledged by Priya (oncall) at 2026-03-15T09:08:21Z.
Cheng (eng-runtime): next steps: push cookie TTL parsing fix to all control-plane hosts, add additional unit tests around pin cookie TTLs, and add an alert for sudden increase in stale-pin-cookie events. filing a postmortem ticket now.
Support (CS): customers notified, CS will follow up with impacted accounts. leaving NRR notes.
Rita (netops): I'll schedule a follow-up to validate edge pin-drain effectiveness across all POPs and ensure no DNS/health-check flaps remain.
Cheng (eng-runtime): filed PM ticket: https://internal.pm/tickets/RI-4269 "stale pin-cookie mis-eval -> cross-region fallback" assigned to eng-runtime. severity: S2.
Priya (oncall): closing the live mitigation thread. if anything new pops up ping @Priya. postmortem owners: Cheng, Luis, Rita. :memo:
StatusBot: RESOLVED: routing anomaly mitigated at 2026-03-15T09:23:09Z. summary: policy tweak + targeted drain + cookie-parsing hotfix canary reduced errors to baseline. followups created.
